newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EVERTON HOPE TO MEET RAVANELLI AT WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EVERTON HOPE TO MEET RAVANELLI AT WEEKEND.

text.p: Everton manager Howard Kendall said on Friday that he hoped to talk to Italian striker Fabrizio Ravanelli this weekend about a move to the English premier league club.

Kendall said Everton had agreed a fee with Ravanelli's present club Middlesbrough, believed to be around 7.5 million pounds ($12.7 million). The manager now wants to agree personal terms with the forward as soon as he could.
"Hopefully he will travel to England as soon as possible, possibly over the weekend," Kendall said on Everton's telephone service for fans.

"I hope to agree a contract and he can join us. It is the first step having agreed a fee with Middlesbrough and been given permission to talk to the player. He is a character and a very good footballer."
Ravanelli, who has three years to run on his contract, has been expected to leave Middlesbrough ever since the club were relegated from the premier league at the end of the season.
The Italian striker had been linked with Everton's city rivals Liverpool but the move fell through. ($ = 0.592 British Pounds)
